name: Classification of Decisions
purpose: A visual aid to facilitate better group decision- making.
whereUsed: The Classification of Decisions aid can be used during any phase of the Assessment Roadmap. By identifying key stakeholders and their role in the decision-making process, everyone has clarity on what is expected of participants.
why: We will establish the roles and expectations for participants involved in making a decision.
outcomes: Acknowledgement of where the decision is within the Assessment Roadmap
Agreement to the level of collaboration and ownership required to make the decision
Focus participants on activities that facilitate the decision making process

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “PROBLEM SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Assess stakeholder/participant roles in the decision at hand
Confirm participant expectations for collaboration in decision-making
Facilitate a candid dialog to capture decision dynamics

spaces.heading: IF WE ARE IN THE “SOLUTION SPACE” WE NEED TO:
steps: Confirm participant expectations for collaboration in decisionmaking
Facilitate a candid dialog to capture decision dynamics
